item.title: feat(onboard): label CLI candidates with subscription vs API-key auth…
item.summary: feat(onboard): label CLI candidates with subscription vs API-key auth (#122140) Detected Codex/Claude Code CLI candidates now say whether they ride a flat-rate subscription login (ChatGPT, Claude) or a metered API key, so picking one is an informed billing decision for an always-on assistant. Codex classification parses `codex login status` output per codex-rs/cli/src/login.rs; Claude uses prompt-free credential-file and env/apiKeyHelper signals only (never the keychain). Unknown states keep the plain 'logged in'. Display-only: ranking and defaults unchanged.
